shadow.note: paper only · FDV-marked at pulse cadence (~33 min) · no fees, slippage or fill modelled — treat every number as an upper bound

retrace-acc-100k-1m.desc: retraced ≥50% from a ≥500k 7d peak, now accumulating/quiet with b/s ≥1, 100k–1m, ≥2d old, liq ≥30k (b-money archetype)

narrative-follower.desc: follower in a cluster whose leader is +50% today; <7d old, <1m fdv, liq ≥20k, b/s ≥1 (beta trade)

retrace-acc-tight.desc: b-money archetype entry (as retrace-acc-100k-1m) with tight exits: stop −25%, take half at 1.3x, trail 0.8×peak (T13)

retrace-acc-breadth.desc: b-money archetype entry, only when ≥35% of live tracked tokens are up on the day (T12 regime filter)

leader-momentum.desc: leader of a named narrative cluster, up ≥30% today, fdv ≥1m, liq ≥100k (capital concentrates in leaders)

flush-in-weak-tape.desc: down ≥30% on the day while <30% of live tracked tokens are up; ≥1d old, liq ≥20k, $50k–$50m (precursor study; out-of-sample test)

quiet-demand-100k-1m.desc: vol/fdv 0.3–1x and 24h change −30–0%, 100k–1m, ≥1d old, liq ≥30k, b/s ≥1 (hypothesis from the looks tables; out-of-sample test)
